content.contractStatement: This architecture contract defines the material authority, transport mechanism, and structural boundaries for the import-discovery-handoff desk in accordance with factory architectural principles and the WP-11F handoff protocol.

corePrinciples.statement: The import-discovery-handoff desk enforces strict protocol version compliance using ek.discovery-handoff-capsule.ek8-wp11f.v1. Any capsule with a stale protocol version is refused at ingress with a typed STALE_PROTOCOL refusal.

All capsule content undergoes cryptographic verification. Every sub-artifact digest is recomputed over its canonical content at ingress, and declared digests are never trusted. The capsule self-address must verify against its canonical facts.

The desk maintains strict lineage binding between discovery and formalization workshops. The capsule must carry the correct lineage ID and parent lifecycle reference matching the expected binding for the target database.

The only legal producing parent state is discovery-terminal. Any capsule from a non-terminal Discovery parent state is refused with an ILLEGAL_PARENT_STATE refusal. This ensures the Discovery lifecycle has properly handed off before formalization begins.

scope: Direct Artifacts: All source claims (SC-1, SC-2, SC-3), constraints (CON-1), unknowns (UNK-1), and terminal claims (TC-1, TC-2)
Trace Relationships: All derivation, constraint, and resolution relationships between artifacts
Protocol Enforcement: WP-11F handoff protocol compliance and version control
Content Verification: Cryptographic verification of all capsule content and sub-artifacts
Lineage Management: Discovery-to-formalization lineage binding and parent state validation
Product Generation: formalization.discovery-import.v1 products with proper evidence references

transportMechanism: Capsule Ingestion: Discovery handoff capsule received via ingestDiscoveryHandoff function
Protocol Validation: Verify schema version matches HANDOFF_PROTOCOL_VERSION
Content Verification: Recompute all SHA256 digests over canonical content
Lineage Check: Validate capsule lineage against expected binding
Parent State Validation: Ensure producing parent is discovery-terminal
Fresh Run Verification: Confirm no active attempts exist in target world
Repository Import: Apply factoryRun.bootstrap and factoryRun.importCapsule commands
Product Generation: Create formalization.discovery-import.v1 product with evidence refs
Trace Recording: Record all artifact relationships and derivations
acceptanceCriteria: All desk artifacts are content-addressed with SHA256 digests
All sub-artifact digests are recomputed and verified
Lineage binding matches expected discovery-formalization connection
No active attempts exist in target database
Complete trace relationship coverage from source to terminal claims
Products of kind formalization.discovery-import.v1 are generated
Evidence references include capsule and all sub-artifact refs
0 accepted upstream revisions travel by content address
compliance: Factory Principles: Content address transport, artifact authority, immutable sealing
WP-11F Protocol: Discovery handoff capsule specification and verification
ingress.ts Laws: Stale protocol, bytes corrupt, bytes missing, foreign lineage, illegal parent state, active attempt refusals
Workspace Requirements: 0 accepted upstream revisions, content address transport, desk artifacts only authority
verification: Immutable artifact sealing before QC boundaries
Structured derivation from source to terminal claims
Valid lineage binding and parent state verification
